item.title: Gracie Abrams Charges to No. 1 In Australia With ‘Daughter From Hell’
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Upbeat music fades out]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update! Let's dive into the top charts. On the ARIA Albums Chart, we have a new number one: Gracie Abrams with 'Daughter From Hell'! This is her second time at the top, following her previous success with 'The Secret Of Us'.
[Short music clip: Gracie Abrams]
Host: "Gracie Abrams is ousting Olivia Rodrigo, who drops to number two with 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love'. And making it an all-female top three, Olivia Dean rises to number three with 'The Art of Loving'.
[Short music clip: Olivia Rodrigo]
Host: "Other notable entries include Motionless in White, who debuts at number five with 'Decades', their highest chart position yet. And new to the chart, we have Steve Lacy with 'Oh Yeah' at number 19, and Holly Hebe's 'Mood Ring' at number 23, which is the top-ranked Australian album this week.
[Short music clip: Motionless in White]
Host: "Over on the ARIA Singles Chart, Ella Langley is still reigning supreme with 'Choosin' Texas' at number one for the seventh non-consecutive week. The top three is all about female artists, with Olivia Dean's 'Man I Need' at number two and her collaboration with Sam Fender, 'Rein Me In', at number three.
[Short music clip: Ella Langley]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in to the latest music update. We'll catch you next time!"
[Upbeat music fades in]
